messages:
Priya Rao: We should lock a postmortem for the 03/14 high-latency pages (inc rwinf-0314). Customer impact: intermittent 5xxs for search traffic for ~35m. Need facilitator + scribe. Who can own facilitation? :wave:

Liam Chen: I can facilitate. Tue/Wed mornings PST work for me. Can take scribe if no one else.

Ava Martinez: I'm happy to scribe but I'm OOO Wed PM. Prefer Tue 10–11 PST.

Priya Rao: Ops, can we get calendar slots? Ops scheduler, thx.

ops-scheduler-bot: Available slots for next week:
• Tue 2026-03-24 10:00-11:00 PST
• Wed 2026-03-25 14:00-15:00 PST
• Thu 2026-03-26 09:00-10:00 PST
Please react with :one:, :two:, :three: to vote.

Sam Ortiz: +1 for Tue slot (one). Also, we should include SRE, infra, and product PM (Marcos).

Priya Rao: @Marcos Rivera please add yourself if you can. Also need someone from infra (tagging @Nora).

Nora Patel: I can attend Tue. Will prep logs and timeline.

Liam Chen: Tue 10 works. I'll facilitate. Ava will scribe. Sam will check customer impacts.

incident-bot: Draft postmortem doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/rwinf-0314-pm-draft (edit rights: Priya, Liam, Ava)

Priya Rao: Great — can someone run the quick log export command and paste results in the doc? Command:
```
./tools/pager/export_logs --incident rwinf-0314 --range 2026-03-14T09:00:00Z/2026-03-14T10:00:00Z > /tmp/rwinf-0314.log
```

Sam Ortiz: Pasted initial error-count timeline into the doc. Also flagged two action items: (1) quiesce autoscaler thresholds; (2) add alert on KV cache evictions.

incident-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/abc123 (Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PST). Invitees: Priya Rao, Liam Chen, Ava Martinez, Sam Ortiz, Nora Patel, Marcos Rivera

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Liam, please add a facilitation checklist in the doc (outline: timeline, root-cause hypotheses, actions, owners, deadlines). I'll follow up with stakeholders after.

Liam Chen: Will do. I'll claim facilitation in the doc and add checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:

Ava Martinez: I'll create meeting notes template in the doc and capture scribe notes during the session.

Priya Rao: Closing thread — see calendar + doc. If availability changes, flag here. :lock:
